method: Official pages were retrieved with the page-fetch tool and compared cell by cell. Targeted official-source search results supplied table headers where the rendered extraction omitted them. This ledger records what was actually read; it is not a claim that a URL prefix proves a value. Raw-byte hashes are only added by the collector when it receives the original HTTP response.

findings.title: Two broadcaster cells contradict the dated final schedule release
findings.stored: MIA at BUF: CBS; TB at DET: FOX
findings.official: MIA at BUF: FOX; TB at DET: CBS
findings.resolution: Use the dated NFL release for the canonical snapshot; preserve the dynamic-page conflict on Flagged for Review.

findings.title: Jaylen Warren rushing touchdowns transcribed as seven instead of two
findings.resolution: Correct the canonical value and retain an audit flag.

findings.title: Ja'Marr Chase receiving touchdowns transcribed as eight instead of seven
findings.resolution: Correct the canonical value and retain an audit flag.

findings.title: REG9 is not the full Week 10 report
findings.official: REG9 displays Week 9; REG10 displays Week 10
findings.resolution: Canonical current-week source is REG10; never infer the route's week from its title alone.

findings.title: Coach outlooks were converted into formal OUT statuses
findings.stored: Puka Nacua: Out (extended); Davante Adams: Out
findings.official: The cited roundup does not publish those formal game-status labels in those statements.
findings.resolution: Leave formal game status null; preserve the coach statement as a separate field.

findings.title: Unsupported knee detail added to Micah Parsons item
findings.official: The cited passage says illness; it does not say knee.
findings.resolution: Remove the unsupported knee detail; practice participation remains Limited.

findings.title: Club charts exist, but official hosting does not make them confirmed lineups
findings.stored: No official club depth chart / club-confirmed chart required as if unavailable
findings.official: Cowboys, Bills, Patriots and Chiefs publish club-hosted charts; several explicitly say unofficial.
findings.resolution: Collect club-published ordering with editorial status. Confirm actual replacements with official gamebook participation/lineup evidence; do not infer them from chart order.

findings.title: Rams identifiers differ across snapshots
findings.official: NFL standings image identifier LA; schedule bye display LAR
findings.resolution: Use a stable internal team key with separate source-native aliases; never join on an ambiguous abbreviation alone.

findings.title: A fixed bet count does not establish skill
findings.stored: A 60% win rate in 500 bets is signal; minimum 500 before live
findings.resolution: Original methodological claim, not an official fact. Replace with price-aware uncertainty, effective sample size, multiplicity control, walk-forward tests and a locked holdout. No count guarantees skill.

findings.title: Overround is not the same as expected book hold
findings.resolution: Mathematical correction: 4.76% is overround. Under balanced proportional assumptions the normalized margin is 0.047619/1.047619 = 4.545%; actual hold depends on wager distribution.

findings.title: Existing validator checks URL prefixes and completeness, not factual agreement
findings.stored: VALIDATION PASSED: all snapshots sourced, complete, arithmetic OK
findings.official: The same baseline contains A-01 through A-06.
findings.resolution: Separate structural checks from source-evidence checks; add mutation tests and exact evidence comparisons.

findings.title: Week 11 was called the next slate while Week 10 was still upcoming
findings.official: Week 10 begins November 12; Week 11 begins November 19.
findings.resolution: Label Week 11 as the planning slate and Week 10 as the current slate on the review date.

findings.title: Published tackle components do not always sum to combined tackles
findings.official: Those component values are published as shown by NFL.com.
findings.resolution: Preserve official values, flag the source inconsistency and suppress any derived sum check until clarified.

findings.title: Unverified qualitative correlation strengths and receiver share are not measurements
findings.stored: Positive (strong); WR1 gets approximately one quarter to one third; often near-independent
findings.resolution: Label as hypotheses only. Publish coefficients only from timestamped paired observations with game-cluster uncertainty and out-of-sample stability.

findings.title: No historical market prices, prop thresholds or settlement contracts are present
findings.stored: Leaderboard empty; odds and settlement questions open
findings.resolution: Keep ROI, CLV, empirical leg correlations and reward eligibility blank. Collect authorized timestamped market archives before evaluating strategies.

findings.title: Two competing public entry points and inconsistent suggestion/question IDs
findings.stored: Root and docs use different registers and navigation
findings.resolution: Generate both public entry points from one canonical dataset and namespace inherited IDs. Preserve prior files in Git history and an explicit archive.

findings.title: No automated ingestion, source-drift detection or scheduled refresh exists in the baseline
findings.resolution: Add a fail-closed official-source collector, immutable response hashes, scheduled collection and explicit publication checks.

findings.title: US helpline information does not answer the user's local legal question
findings.official: NCPG describes a US helpline/local-resource network; it does not establish Netherlands betting legality.
findings.resolution: Default to paper-only research, no wager placement, no monetary rewards and no assumption of legal eligibility.
